_comment: Synthetic golden set (10 cases) for evals/scorers/extraction_scorer.py. source_text is a synthetic clause (not copied verbatim from any real regulation text) written to be structurally realistic. Every expected_obligations[].verbatim_quote is an EXACT substring of that case's source_text -- this is the ground truth an extraction run is compared against, not something the model needs to reproduce exactly (fuzzy/normalized span matching still applies via src/verify/span.py). Each case also carries one applicability scenario (a bank_profile + expected_applies) so extraction and applicability can both be scored per case.

cases.source_text: Financial entities shall report major ICT-related incidents to the competent authority within 24 hours of detection, using the standardised reporting template referred to in Article 20.

expected_obligations.obligation_text: Report major ICT-related incidents to the competent authority within 24 hours of detection
expected_obligations.verbatim_quote: shall report major ICT-related incidents to the competent authority within 24 hours of detection

cases.source_text: Financial entities shall maintain and update at least annually a register of information on all contractual arrangements with ICT third-party service providers, distinguishing between arrangements supporting critical or important functions and those that do not.

expected_obligations.obligation_text: Maintain and update at least annually a register of information on ICT third-party contractual arrangements
expected_obligations.verbatim_quote: shall maintain and update at least annually a register of information on all contractual arrangements with ICT third-party service providers

cases.source_text: Financial entities may, where proportionate to their size and overall risk profile, rely on pooled testing arrangements coordinated by a third party to satisfy the digital operational resilience testing programme requirement.

expected_obligations.obligation_text: May rely on pooled, third-party-coordinated testing arrangements to satisfy the resilience testing programme, where proportionate
expected_obligations.verbatim_quote: may, where proportionate to their size and overall risk profile, rely on pooled testing arrangements coordinated by a third party

cases.source_text: Financial entities shall establish, document, and periodically test an ICT business continuity policy setting out recovery time objectives and recovery point objectives for critical or important functions.

expected_obligations.obligation_text: Establish, document, and periodically test an ICT business continuity policy with defined RTOs/RPOs for critical functions
expected_obligations.verbatim_quote: shall establish, document, and periodically test an ICT business continuity policy setting out recovery time objectives and recovery point objectives

cases.source_text: Essential and important entities shall submit an early warning to the competent CSIRT without undue delay and in any event within 24 hours of becoming aware of a significant incident, followed by a full incident notification within 72 hours.

expected_obligations.obligation_text: Submit an early warning within 24 hours and a full incident notification within 72 hours of becoming aware of a significant incident
expected_obligations.verbatim_quote: shall submit an early warning to the competent CSIRT without undue delay and in any event within 24 hours of becoming aware of a significant incident

cases.source_text: Essential and important entities shall implement appropriate and proportionate technical, operational, and organisational measures to manage the risks posed to the security of network and information systems, following an all-hazards approach.

expected_obligations.obligation_text: Implement proportionate technical, operational, and organisational risk-management measures following an all-hazards approach
expected_obligations.verbatim_quote: shall implement appropriate and proportionate technical, operational, and organisational measures to manage the risks posed to the security of network and information systems

cases.source_text: Essential entities shall address supply chain security, including security-related aspects concerning the relationships between each entity and its direct suppliers or service providers, as part of their risk management measures.

expected_obligations.obligation_text: Address supply chain security in relationships with direct suppliers and service providers as part of risk management
expected_obligations.verbatim_quote: shall address supply chain security, including security-related aspects concerning the relationships between each entity and its direct suppliers or service providers

cases.source_text: Banks must maintain a minimum Common Equity Tier 1 capital ratio of 4.5% of risk-weighted assets at all times, in addition to the capital conservation buffer.

expected_obligations.obligation_text: Maintain a minimum CET1 capital ratio of 4.5% of risk-weighted assets at all times
expected_obligations.verbatim_quote: must maintain a minimum Common Equity Tier 1 capital ratio of 4.5% of risk-weighted assets at all times

cases.source_text: Banks must hold sufficient high-quality liquid assets to cover total net cash outflows over a 30 calendar-day liquidity stress scenario, maintaining a liquidity coverage ratio of at least 100%.

expected_obligations.obligation_text: Maintain a liquidity coverage ratio of at least 100% over a 30-day stress scenario
expected_obligations.verbatim_quote: must hold sufficient high-quality liquid assets to cover total net cash outflows over a 30 calendar-day liquidity stress scenario

cases.source_text: A bank's exposure to a single counterparty or group of connected counterparties must not exceed 25% of the bank's available Tier 1 capital, except where a specific exemption applies to exposures to sovereigns.

expected_obligations.obligation_text: Limit single-counterparty (or connected group) exposure to no more than 25% of available Tier 1 capital
expected_obligations.verbatim_quote: must not exceed 25% of the bank's available Tier 1 capital
